A bustling month on feeding routines, minutes
The lead dispatcher welcomed everyone
Attendees were Rina Kim, Hugo Suleiman, and Hazel.

The team reviewed companion handling, crate comfort, and clearer handoffs at check-in. <<FACT F104>> Staff agreed that calm wording at the counter keeps travelers relaxed and pets settled. Extra care will be given to feeding notes, water access, and preflight confirmation so each file stays consistent. <<FACT F091>> The group also noted that escalation should remain stepwise, with concerns shared early and resolved by the senior coordinator when needed.

Support for Aurelia Skyways remains steady, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue careful monitoring of bookings, updates, and pet welfare. The meeting ended with agreement on the next review and confidence in the current process.
